description.en: Curated ecosystem and exploration lab for emerging shadcn/ui community registries.
description.zh: 汇集前沿新兴 shadcn/ui 社区注册表、扩展库与开发工具的生态实验聚合站。

content.en: Shadcn Labs is an experimental portal indexing the rapidly growing universe of community-built shadcn extensions, third-party registries, and design system tools. It tracks cutting-edge innovations and facilitates cross-registry component discovery.
content.zh: Shadcn Labs 是一个追踪并聚合全球 shadcn/ui 开源生态前沿动向的创新实验室与索引平台。它系统性梳理了社区涌现的个性化 Registry、三方扩展库、自动化脚本与主题工具，是洞察现代化前端分发趋势的极佳窗口。
